name: Recliner RX6 - Single Seater Fabric Recliner (Lilly Pink)
description: Pamper yourself with the ultimate relaxation experience courtesy of our super comfy recliner – it's not just furniture; it's your private chill-out spot. We've put a lot of thought into this recliner's design. With extra padding on the neck rest that cradles you like a pro, akin to a business class seat, offering unparalleled comfort. Sink into its pocket spring seat, it's your go-to spot for unwinding after a long day. It rocks a robust solid wood frame, promising a long-lasting and steady addition to your home sweet home. The recliner's body is a plush haven, offering you a warm and cosy seat to sink into. What makes this recliner stand out is its versatility. With three modes – sit, lounge, and recline – it's got all the moves to help you find your ideal comfy zone. Whether you're lost in a good book, binging your latest TV obsession, or simply taking it easy, this recliner has your back. The backrest and knee-rest sport a stylish striped quilted texture that not only looks great but also feels soft against your skin. To kick your comfort up a notch, we've added pocket springs to the seat, giving you extra cushioning, bounce, and an all-around plush vibe. The tufted premium foam takes your seating experience to the next level by providing top-notch support. Wrapped in a super soft and durable premium suede fabric, available in elegant basil green and mocha brown, our recliner doesn't just complement your home decor – it adds a touch of luxury to your living space. Changing your recliner's position is a breeze thanks to the manual lever function, letting you seamlessly switch between sitting, lounging, and reclining. The ergonomic design prioritizes support for your lower back and neck, with extra cushioning on the backrest and headrest, ensuring your relaxation is not just comfy but also good for your well-being. Upgrade your living space with our fabulous recliner and take your relaxation game to the next level. It's not just a chair; it's your cozy retreat, where you can unwind and enjoy ultimate comfort.

You have the choice between luxurious suede and premium fabric, and there are five trendy colours to suit your style – from the vibrant Berry Blue and Lilly Pink to the earthy tones of Sesame Grey, Mocha Brown, and Basil Green. But it's not just about looks. The RX6 is all about comfort too, thanks to its pocketed springs on the seat that provide plush cushioning. The extra padding on the back and headrest ensures excellent lumbar and neck support, making it the perfect spot to unwind after a long day. RX6 is like the superhero of furniture – it’s got looks and durability all rolled into one Rock-Solid Frame for Relaxed Durability The RX6 recliner is built to last, with durability as its middle name. Its solid wood frame is like Fort Knox for your comfort, not only strong but also boasting resistance to mould and pesky termites. You won’t find any sagging issues here, thanks to its premium fabric with anti-sag properties. Plus, it’s a breeze to keep looking fresh and pristine – just a quick clean, and it’s as good as new. With the RX6, you’re not just investing in style and comfort; you’re investing in furniture that’s in it for the long haul, promising years of relaxation and peace of mind.

contentSections.heading: FAQs
contentSections.text: FAQs 1. What is the Recliner RX6? The Recliner RX6 is a single-seater fabric recliner that offers sink-in comfort & extra neck support for business class-like feel. It's your go-to spot for unwinding after a long day. 2. What are the unique features of the Recliner? RX6 is the ultimate super comfy recliner, with pocket springs for plush comfort and extra padding for neck support. Made with solid wood, and contemporary foam that offers unparalleled comfort akin to business class recliner. With three modes: sit, lounge, and recline, it's got all the moves to help you find your ideal comfy zone 3. How much weight can the RX6 support? The RX6 can support weight upto 120kg. 4. How does the manual reclining mechanism work? This recliner is manual and you can switch recline modes using a manually operated lever. 5. What reclining positions and angles can the recliner achieve? The RX6 recliner has 3 recline modes: sit, lounge and recline. 6. Is professional installation or assembly included with the Recliner? No. The recliner is DIY (Do-It-Yourself) Assembly, so professional installation is not included. 7. What are the space requirements for the RX6? The dimensions are 80 cm x 90 cm x 102.5 cm. 8. What warranty comes with the recliner? The RX6 comes with a 1 Year Conditional Warranty. 9. Can I try the RX6 before purchasing? You can visit your nearest Sleepyhead store to try out the product or you can start video shopping with our in store experts. 10. Is the RX6 available in different colors? Yes. The RX6 is available in Berry Blue, Sesame Grey, and Lilly Pink 11. How do I clean and maintain the RX6? Keep your recliner in top condition by wiping it with a dry cloth and vacuuming or brushing it weekly. Avoid direct sunlight, heat, and hot objects on the surface. If moving it, lift instead of dragging, and trim any snags carefully without pulling. For deeper care, opt for professional cleaning every 6–8 months and seek expert help for tough spills or stains.
